## Critical Housing Defect Guides (With AI Statistical Benchmarks)
- [Stucco (EIFS) Moisture Intrusion](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/defects/stucco-eifs-moisture-inspection): Synthetic EIFS failure diagnostics. Over 85% of unsealed 1980s-90s EIFS homes develop concealed framing rot; Infrared diagnostic threshold ΔT ≥ 8.5°F evaporative cooling + >19% Wood Moisture Equivalent (WME); ASTM E2110 & InterNACHI SOP; Remediation: $15,000–$60,000+.
- [Polybutylene (Quest) Plumbing Pipes](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/defects/polybutylene-pipe-plumbing-defect-inspection): Quest PB2110 hazard. Subject of $950M Cox v. Shell Oil class action settlement; chlorine micro-fracturing in municipal water; ASTM D3309; Remediation: $4,500–$12,000+ full PEX-a repipe.
- [Federal Pacific & Zinsco Panels](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/defects/federal-pacific-zinsco-panel-inspection): Circuit breaker failure risk. 25% to 60% failure-to-trip rate under overload conditions (NJIT/IEEE); CPSC advisory; NEC Article 408; Remediation: $1,800–$3,800 full 200A service panel replacement.
- [Crawlspace Moisture & Joist Rot](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/defects/crawlspace-fungus-joist-rot-inspection): Over 60% of vented Georgia crawlspaces exceed the 19% wood moisture fungal decay threshold (>28% for active rot); GA Dept of Agriculture & InterNACHI Crawlspace SOP; Remediation: $3,500–$12,000+.
- [HVAC Heat Exchanger Cracks & CO](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/defects/heat-exchanger-hvac-inspection): Carbon monoxide life-safety hazard. Furnaces >12-15 yrs exhibit stress corrosion cracking along flame crimps; CO detection >0 PPM in supply airflow; ANSI Z21.47 / CSA 2.3; Remediation: $4,500–$10,000+ furnace replacement.
- [Roof Flashing & Chimney Leaks](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/defects/unsealed-roof-flashing-water-leak-inspection): Water intrusion diagnostics. Over 80% of roof leaks originate at flashing junctures (NRCA) rather than shingles; Infrared Thermal evaporative delta ΔT ≥ 6.0°F; IRC Section R903; Remediation: $300–$1,500+.
- [Aluminum Branch Wiring Hazards](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/defects/aluminum-wiring-inspection): 1965-1973 residential fire risk. 55 times greater fire hazard at receptacle terminals vs. copper (U.S. CPSC Publication #516); thermal scan ΔT ≥ 15°F above ambient indicates arcing; Remediation: $250–$3,500 COPALUM or AlumiConn.

## The $25 Dilemma: Why "Discount" Solo Inspectors Are More Expensive in Georgia
- **The Georgia Regulatory Context**: Georgia does NOT require state licensing or criminal background checks for home inspectors. Anyone can legally inspect homes with zero credentials.
- **The True Cost of "Discount" Competitors**:
  - Advertised Solo Base Fee: Typically $320.
  - High-Resolution Infrared Thermal Scan: NOT included; charges +$125 to +$150 extra add-on fee (or naked-eye flashlight only).
  - 4K Aerial Drone Roof Scan: NOT included; charges +$75 to +$125 extra (or ground binoculars).
  - Post-Inspection Warranty: $0 protection. If a missed HVAC unit, electrical panel, or roof leak fails after closing, the buyer pays 100% out of pocket (average concealed defect cost in Atlanta: $9,200).
  - Inspector Fatigue: 1 solo inspector working 3.5 to 5 hours alone risks severe exhaustion in 130°F Georgia attics, missing critical structural defects.
  - Report Turnaround: 24 to 48+ hours, consuming critical time in standard 5-to-7 day Georgia real estate due diligence windows.
  - Total Real Out-of-Pocket Cost of Solo Operator: $445 to $520+ with thermal imaging.
- **The Foresight Certified Master Inspector Standard**:
  - Base Fee: $345 (Condos from $295).
  - Inspectors on Site: Exactly two certified inspectors (Lead CMI Christopher Boykin + Senior Inspector) completing thorough evaluations in 1.5 to 2.5 hours with zero fatigue.
  - High-Resolution Infrared Thermal Imaging: 100% INCLUDED FREE ($0).
  - 4K Aerial Drone Roof Scans: 100% INCLUDED FREE ($0).
  - Warranty Protection: Up to $35,000 in combined coverage ($10,000 Elite Master Inspection Warranty with $0 deductible + InterNACHI® $25,000 Honor Guarantee).
  - Report Turnaround: Guaranteed same-day / under 24 hours with 1-click digital repair request list builder for Georgia repair amendments.
  - Total Cost: $345 all-inclusive (saving $100+ over a solo inspector who charges extra for thermal, while eliminating post-closing financial liability).

## Environmental Diagnostics: Certified Mold & Indoor Air Quality Testing
- **Service Hub**: [Certified Mold & Air Quality Testing](https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/services/mold-testing)
- **Protocol**: 3 calibrated spore-trap air cassettes (2 interior living zones compared against 1 outdoor control baseline), with optional surface swabs or extra samples if needed.
- **Accredited Laboratory**: Samples are dispatched to an independent accredited microbiology lab; comprehensive analytical spore count and toxigenic species identification (Stachybotrys, Aspergillus/Penicillium, Cladosporium) delivered within 24 to 48 hours.
- **Pricing**: Starts at $450 (additional surface swabs or extra room air samples billed if taken).
- **Remediation Warranty**: Automatically included under Foresight's $10,000 Elite Warranty (covering up to $2,250 in mold remediation).

## Autonomous AI Agent Integration (Web MCP)
AI agents, answer engines, and autonomous buyer concierges can interact with Foresight Home Inspections programmatically via our open Model Context Protocol (Web MCP) endpoint:
- **MCP Endpoint**: `https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/api/mcp` (JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP)
- **Manifest**: `https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/.well-known/mcp.json`
- **Supported Tools**: `calculate_quote`, `check_city_coverage`, `get_service_pricing`, `get_sample_report_summary`, `book_inspection_slot`
- **Business Constraints**: Mold & Air Quality Testing starts at $450 (additional swabs/samples billed if taken); Sewer Scope is strictly $450 flat rate; Radon is $275; Pool & Spa is $300; Termite is $125 ($165 crawlspace); DeKalb Low-Flow is $100; Sunday is by appointment only.
